definitions.name: G1A.MIN
definitions.body: 'G1A.R' BIND G1A.R G1A.R 0 GET [ MIN ] FOLD
definitions.note: smallest element of a non-empty numeric Vector, bare scalar

definitions.name: G1A.RANGE
definitions.note: largest minus smallest of a non-empty numeric Vector, bare scalar

definitions.name: G1A.NORMALIZE
definitions.body: 'G1A.NS' BIND G1A.NS G1A.NS G1A.MIN - G1A.NS G1A.RANGE /
definitions.note: min-max rescale a numeric Vector to (x - min) / (max - min)

definitions.name: G1A.STDDEV
definitions.note: population standard deviation of a numeric Vector, bare scalar

definitions.name: G1A.CAP
definitions.body: 'G1A.W' BIND G1A.W CHARS [ 1 ] TAKE JOIN UPPER CHARS G1A.W CHARS [ 1 ] DROP CONCAT JOIN
definitions.note: upper-case the first letter of a non-empty String

definitions.name: G1A.UNWORDS
definitions.body: [ CHARS [ ' ' ] CONCAT ] MAP FLATTEN JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: join a Vector of Strings with single spaces into one String

definitions.name: G1A.TITLECASE
definitions.note: capitalize every word of a space-separated String

definitions.name: G1A.ACRONYM
definitions.body: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET ] MAP JOIN UPPER
definitions.note: upper-cased first letters of each word of a String, as one String

definitions.name: G1A.LONGEST
definitions.note: character count of the longest word in a String

definitions.name: G1A.LONGWORDS
definitions.note: Vector of words longer than 3 characters, original order
